cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

mechanism: A presents a confident plan built around A, then yields preferences and tasks so B will choose A over the existing alternative.
confusable: Distinguish accommodating someone generally from using each concession to favor A against a named competing person or obligation.
comparison: Birthday invitation competes with concert and friend dancing; expedition photography competes with Martin through sponsor needs.
seedUse: Canonical cake/dancing and French/sponsor seeds supply real rival choices; S02 should absorb B terms while keeping a confident provider role, not just prefixing please.
